name: Law2_PolyhedraGeom_PolyhedraPhys_Volumetric
description: Calculate physical response of 2 Polyhedra in interaction, based on penetration configuration given by PolyhedraGeom. Normal force is proportional to the volume of intersection

attributes.name: traceEnergy
attributes.description: Define the total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all contacts. This will trace only plastic energy in this law, see O.trackEnergy for a more complete energies tracing

attributes.name: volumePower
attributes.description: Power of volume used in evaluation of normal force. Default is 1.0 - normal force is linearly proportional to volume. 1.0/3.0 would mean that normal force is proportional to the cube root of volume, approximation of penetration depth.

methods.name: elasticEnergy
methods.description: Compute and return the total elastic energy in all "FrictPhys" contacts

methods.name: initPlasticDissipation
methods.description: Initialize cummulated plastic dissipation to a value (0 by default).

methods.name: plasticDissipation
methods.description: Total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all FrictPhys contacts. Computed only if Law2_PolyhedraGeom_PolyhedraPhys_Volumetric::traceEnergy is true.
